exposure: 2-hour postprandial free fatty acid (2h-FFA) levels at mid-pregnancy
fasting free fatty acid (FFA) levels at mid-pregnancy
cohort: The study included 710 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM).
finding: In women with GDM, a high 2h-FFA level at mid-pregnancy, but not fasting FFA, was associated with an increased risk of delivering LGA newborns.
birth_weight: birthweights of newborns above the 90th percentile for their gestational age
gest_age: used in the definition of large-for-gestational-age (LGA) newborns
